en.45d5b742: For rheumatoid-type arthritis, osteoarthritis, and ankylosing spondylitis, adults take 1 to 2 tablets (275 to 550 mg) per dose, 2 times a day (every 12 hours). For acute gout, take 3 tablets (825 mg) as the first dose, then 1 tablet (275 mg) every 8 hours until the attack subsides. For musculoskeletal disorders, post-operative pain, pain after tooth extraction, dysmenorrhea, tendinitis, and bursitis, take 2 tablets (550 mg) as the first dose, then 1 tablet (275 mg) every 6 to 8 hours, and do not exceed a total of 5 tablets (1,375 mg) per day.
